nodes.title: Live STT for the India app: MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming (southindia) becomes primary with taxila-live-transcribe as automatic fallback, because from Chennai it returned final text in 68 ms p50 vs 753 ms (n=20) and was at least as accurate on the synthetic Hinglish set (cerNorm 0.021 vs 0.028, answers 78/78 vs 76/78, CIs overlap). Supersedes stt-default-live-transcribe-kw-reaffirmed for the India lane. Risks kept visible: Preview model, cannot take lesson keywords, unmetered price. Reverse if real-child audio (E1) shows worse accuracy, or it leaves Preview at a price above gpt-live-transcribe
